questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Det var vigtigt for mig at vælge et sted med mange internationale studerende og fede events.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: KU Leuven har en nem hjemmeside at finde rundt på.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Det er nogle gode orienteringsdage med stort set alt information. Desuden kan man også søge at få en lokal studerende som 'hjælper', dette kalder de for bodies.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing through my host institution

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: On campus

questions.question: What options were available for on campus housing? *
questions.answer: Man kan søger i alt 3 kollegier som er udbudt af universitetet

questions.question: What options were available for meal plans or cooking facilities? *
questions.answer: Der var køleskab, fryser og skabsplads, samt mikroovn og kogeplader. Ovn og køkkengrej skal man selv sørge for eller undvære.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living in on campus housing? *
questions.answer: Kollegierne er nice fordi her møder man også lokale studerende, samt holde de forskellige events. Jeg boede på Pauscollege, som var virkelig fedt. Dog er de Belgiske studerende ikke særlig renlige.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: De første to uger kan man prøver forskellige fag før at man endeligt vælger.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Der er et orienteringsmøde om valg af fag, samt et kontor for udvekslingsstuderende som man kan spørge.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Holdene har ikke nogen maks antal studerende, derfor kan man få de fag som bliver udbudt.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Prøv forskellige fag af i starten. Og vær forberedt på at skriftlige eksaminerne er i hånden.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Da man har flere fag end på KU er der et større arbejdspres, da man skal junglere mere og også læse mere. Eksaminerne var klart svære end på KU.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Ofte er undervisningen med sæd og lyt. Men nogle professorer har også diskussionsklasser eller åbner forelæsning for diskussion.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
Introduction to anthropology in a decolonisation
Power, politics and culture in a postcapitalist..
Population, climate change & society
Health, genomics & society
Sociological theory in action
Culture and meaning

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer:
Jeg syntes især om Power, politics og decolonisation, da disse fag var meget antropologiske og teoretiske. 

Health, genomics var også meget fedt, da vi her havde diskussionstimer, og det er et spændende emne.

Housing DKK per month *
Books DKK per month *
Local transportation DKK per month *
Food DKK per month *
Personal spending DKK per month *
Communication (phone, internet, etc.) DKK per month *

What unexpected costs did you encounter? *
questions.answer:
At jeg skulle ud og købe tallerkner, glas, gryde, viskestykke etc.
Jeg skulle også vaske tøj på laundromats hvilket kostede 10 euros pr gang for vask og tørretumbling.

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer: Jeg skulle også vaske tøj på laundromats hvilket kostede 10 euros pr gang for vask og tørretumbling.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer:
Universitetet tilbyder gratis træning til udvekslingsstuderende - det er holdtræning, og boldspil, samt en svømmehal. 
Zed cinema har billige biograf film.
Pangaea har forskellige events som talks og karaokeaften

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Alle ovennævnte

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: De andre byer i Belgien som: Antwerpen, Gent, Brugge og Bruxelles.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Okay

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer:
Bo et sted med lokalestuderende. 
Med de mange skiftende fag lærer man ikke side medstuderende så godt at kende, det er mere venenr fra introdagene og der hvor man bor.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Selvstændighed. Mange belgiske studerende tager hjem til deres forældre hver weekend.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Dem jeg boede med hvor virkelige sjove og åbne.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
skriftlig eksamen i hånden. 
Få venner i introdagene. 
Have fun.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: nope

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer:
Det er altid udfordrende at skulle skabe et liv for sig selv et nyt sted - men også virkelig givende. 
Fedt at studere i en lille universitetsby. Masser af hyggelige caféer og liv.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Det lidt konservative skolesystem.

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
